description: This file defines the WorkWeekService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, responsible for managing interactions with the WorkWeek Data Access Object (DAO). It provides a method to retrieve the DAO, initializing it if not already set.

classes.name: WorkWeekService
classes.description: Service class for handling operations related to work weeks within the leave module.

methods.name: getWorkWeekDao
methods.description: Retrieves the WorkWeekDao instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.
